name: Hard To Swallow Pills
look: Two stacked illustrations in a soft wikiHow-like style. Top: two hands hold a white pill bottle with a label reading "Hard to swallow pills," one finger pointing at it. Bottom: an open palm holds two white pills, one stamped 54 543, while a finger points at them.
use: Delivers uncomfortable truths. The bottle sets up the theme, and the truth someone doesn't want to accept is written over the pills in the bottom panel, usually a blunt fact that stings.
slots: text over the pills in the bottom panel: the uncomfortable truth
examples: Buying a planner does not make you organized
